_experiment.description: Full-budget (2160-step) version of e09_magnitude_search.json: drive the selector to complete exhaustion of the 2160 prunable weights to locate its empirical collapse (stupidity) point, mirroring e05_stupidity_point for the manifold selector. Same seed-0 dense baseline network (artifact-reuse), B=10000, do_adjust=true.
literature: Han et al. 2015: magnitude pruning competitive when paired with retraining — this checks whether the same holds with manifold adjust instead
Molchanov et al. 2019: systematic comparison of magnitude, first-order Taylor, and second-order importance metrics
